Card Q&A.q: My opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon, or I have 3 or more [Hero] trait Tamers with different names. Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect at the same time as an effect such as P-105 [Physical Training]'s effect that digivolves?

Effect: [Your Turn] While your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon or you have 3 or more [Hero] trait Tamers with different names, this Digimon may digivolve into [ShineGreymon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
